# Scopes: let, letv, set, def, closures, globals.

=== let local
(let ((x 10)) x)
--- want
10

=== let two bindings
(let ((a 10) (b 20)) (+ a b))
--- want
30

=== let is sequential
(let ((x 1) (y (+ x 1))) y)
--- want
2

=== let shadowing
(let ((x 1)) (let ((x 2)) x))
--- want
2

=== let outer access
(let ((x 1)) (let ((y 2)) x))
--- want
1

=== let inner does not leak
(let ((x 1)) (let ((x 2)) x) x)
--- want
1

=== let body is a sequence
(let ((x 1)) (set x 2) (set x 3) x)
--- want
3

=== let empty bindings
(let () 5)
--- want
5

=== let needs a body
(let ((x 1)))
--- error

=== let needs bindings
(let)
--- error

=== let binding must be a pair
(let (x) x)
--- error

=== let binding without value
(let ((x)) x)
--- error

=== let binding name must be a symbol
(let ((1 2)) 1)
--- error

=== letv destructures a tuple
(letv (a b) (tuple 1 2) (+ a b))
--- want
3

=== letv with values
(letv (a b) (values 2 3) (+ a b))
--- want
5

=== letv empty
(letv () (values) 1)
--- want
1

=== letv arity mismatch, too few
(letv (a b) (values 1) a)
--- error

=== letv arity mismatch, too many
(letv (a) (values 1 2) a)
--- error

=== letv needs a tuple
(letv (a) (list 1) a)
--- error

=== letv does not alias the tuple
(let ((tup (values 5 6)))
  (letv (a b) tup (set a 99))
  tup)
--- want
(tuple 5 6)

=== set local
(let ((x 1)) (do (set x 2) x))
--- want
2

=== set returns the value
(let ((x 1)) (set x 7))
--- want
7

=== set outer from inner scope
(let ((x 1)) (let ((y 2)) (set x 5)) x)
--- want
5

=== set unbound creates a global
(set y 5)
--- want
5
--- globals
y = 5

=== set global then read
(do (set y 5) y)
--- want
5

=== set name must be a symbol
(set 1 2)
--- error

=== set arity
(set)
--- error

=== undefined global
y
--- error

=== undefined symbol in expression
(+ missing 1)
--- error

=== def global
(do (def g 100) g)
--- want
100
--- globals
g = 100

=== def then set
(do (def g 1) (set g 2) g)
--- want
2
--- globals
g = 2

=== def inside a function is still global
(do ((fn () (def inner 9))) inner)
--- want
9
--- globals
inner = 9

=== def needs a value
(def z)
--- error

=== def name must be a symbol
(def 1 2)
--- error

=== read a given global
given x = 5
(* x 2)
--- want
10

=== given list global
given xs = (list 1 2 3)
(length xs)
--- want
3

=== given string global
given ENV = "prod"
(if (= ENV "prod") "https://app.example.com" "http://localhost")
--- want
"https://app.example.com"

=== set overwrites a given global
given Address = "http://localhost"
(set Address "https://example.com")
--- want
"https://example.com"
--- globals
Address = "https://example.com"

=== given globals untouched are returned
given a = 1
(set b 2)
--- want
2
--- globals
a = 1
b = 2

=== closure captures a local
(let ((x 10)) ((fn (y) (+ x y)) 5))
--- want
15

=== closure sees later mutation of its captured variable
(let ((x 1)) (let ((f (fn () x))) (set x 2) (f)))
--- want
2

=== closure mutates its captured variable
(let ((x 1)) (let ((f (fn () (set x (+ x 1)) x))) (f) (f) x))
--- want
3

=== closure factory
(do
  (def make-adder (fn (k) (fn (x) (+ x k))))
  (def add5 (make-adder 5))
  (add5 10))
--- want
15

=== two closures keep separate captures
(do
  (def make-adder (fn (k) (fn (x) (+ x k))))
  (def add1 (make-adder 1))
  (def add5 (make-adder 5))
  (list (add1 10) (add5 10)))
--- want
(list 11 15)

=== recursion factorial
(let () (def fact (fn (n) (if (<= n 1) 1 (* n (fact (- n 1)))))) (fact 5))
--- want
120

=== recursion fibonacci
(do
  (def fib (fn (n) (if (< n 2) n (+ (fib (- n 1)) (fib (- n 2))))))
  (fib 10))
--- want
55

=== multiple top-level expressions, last wins
(+ 1 1)
(+ 2 2)
--- want
4

=== multiple top-level expressions share globals
(set x 10)
(set y 20)
(+ x y)
--- want
30
--- globals
x = 10
y = 20

=== special form name is free as a variable
(let ((if 1)) if)
--- want
1

=== special form in head position is not shadowed
(let ((if 1)) (if #t 2 3))
--- want
2
